verdict.rationale: Logseq documents block/page properties via `key:: value` syntax (e.g. `publish:: true`) and tags (e.g. tagging a block with `#Page` in the DB version). It also offers `{{query}}` simple queries for retrieval, so the core of attaching metadata and querying it is evidenced. However, typed property schemas and consistent tag/property-based organization are never documented directly; they are only implied by these incidental examples. missing for 10: documentation of typed property definitions/schemas, evidence of querying or filtering by properties and tags, independent or hands-on corroboration of consistent property/tag workflows.
